transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to run the package-lock routine for the 'Midnight Arcade' delivery. Can I get signoff from rights, post-production, and publicity on the current draft package? We have worldwide delivery, the studio's standard music credit, a 4K UHD 24 fps master, English subtitles, and a June 14 publicity release date listed. Please flag any required changes from your departments before I give final approval.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I need to flag two required changes from the rights department. I reviewed the countersigned music license this morning, and it restricts distribution to the United States and Canada only — not worldwide as currently listed. Also, the required music credit must read exactly 'Music licensed courtesy of Northline Songs,' not the studio's standard music credit. I haven't entered these terms into the delivery tracker yet because the rights database migration is still open, but the license is signed and binding.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag required changes from post-production. I received the broadcaster's completed ingest test today, and it confirms that delivery must be an IMF package at 25 fps with English SDH captions. The current draft's 4K UHD 24 fps master and ordinary English subtitle file will fail the partner's ingest specification. I have the test result in the post-production test folder.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to flag a required change from publicity. I confirmed with the artist's representative this afternoon that publicity for 'Midnight Arcade' is embargoed until June 21 — not June 14 as currently listed in the draft package. The representative will reject any public release dated earlier than June 21. I have the approval email on file, though it's currently attached to the publicity calendar rather than the delivery tracker.
transcript.speaker: A4
